t: The Flomasta brass compression reducing coupler is a robust pipe fitting designed for plumbing professionals. This essential component facilitates a secure and leak-proof connection between pipes of differing sizes, specifically reducing from 15mm to 12mm. Manufactured from high-quality brass, it offers durability and reliability for various plumbing installations and repairs. It is ideal for connecting a larger main pipe to a smaller appliance feed or extending existing pipework in both domestic and commercial environments, ensuring efficient and long-lasting performance.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
